headline: ADA: open-source AI data analyst shows its math, keeps your data local
summary: ADA is an open-source AI data analyst that processes CSV/Excel files locally, providing dashboards, forecasts, and plain-English answers with transparent calculations. It ensures data privacy by keeping rows off AI APIs.
details: ADA is a new open-source AI data analyst designed to provide transparent, deterministic insights from your data. It addresses the common issue of LLMs giving inconsistent or untraceable calculations by separating the analysis from the AI interpretation.

Users can upload CSV or Excel files to generate a dashboard, anomaly detection, and forecasts. All calculations are performed locally using pandas, ensuring that sensitive data never leaves your server or goes to external AI APIs.

An optional LLM layer can be used, but it only processes column names, not the actual data rows, maintaining privacy. The core functionality works without any API keys, offering a fully local data analysis solution.

Developed as a solo project and released under an MIT license, ADA is open to contributors. The creator aims to make the tool as LLM-free as possible to ensure maximum determinism and reliability in its analytical outputs.
caption:
Stop trusting LLMs with your raw data and their math. ADA is an open-source AI data analyst that processes your CSV/Excel files locally, showing every calculation.
